headline: Jamie Dimon Just Named Five Threats to the Economy. JPMorgan Is Already Acting
summary: The head of America's biggest bank just fit five threats to the economy into a single sentence: deficits, sticky inflation, elevated asset prices, rising rates and geopolitics. Finally, we'll discuss why the biggest bank in the country tightening its lending while times look good is a signal worth watching.
